newsitem.title: USA: Liberty not to hold merger talks with BOK.
newsitem.headline: Liberty not to hold merger talks with BOK.

text.p: Liberty Bancorp said on Wednesday its board of directors unanimously voted not to undertake discussions with BOK Financial Corp regarding a possible business combination between them.
BOK had recently asked Liberty to discuss a possible combination and had proposed several forms of consideration and transaction structures, including a merger, Liberty said.
The board of directors, who own 40 percent of Liberty stock, said a business combination was not in the best interest of shareholders, employees or the company.
A merger between the two would also not be possible under Oklahoma state deposit cap laws, Liberty said.
